# Hafiz Afaq (AI Guy)

> AI filmmaker and creative director based in Karachi, Pakistan, making AI video ads, UGC ads, brand films and educational series for brands in the US, UK and worldwide. Each case study shows the final film, character sheets, sets, prompts and edit.

## Services
- [AI UGC ads](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/services/ai-ugc-ads/): AI UGC ads for TikTok, Reels and Meta: selfie testimonials, founder interviews and family-reaction ads with one consistent face and your real product.
- [AI video ads & brand films](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/services/ai-video-ads/): AI video ad production for brands in the US, UK and worldwide: character story ads, product films, B2B brand films and spec spots, cast, lit and edited like a real shoot.
- [AI kids & educational videos](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/services/ai-educational-videos/): AI kids rhymes and educational lesson videos for learning brands: locked characters, correct letters and numbers, original songs and an enrollment call at the end.
- [AI VFX & post-production](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/services/ai-vfx-post-production/): AI and Python VFX for brand footage: background replacement, product fixes on real UGC, seamless website hero loops and finishing, all without a reshoot.

## Case studies
- [ULTRA: A bear dad, a dog best friend, and one tin.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/ultra/): Character story ad. A three-minute story ad where every lead is an animal, and each one has to be the same animal in every scene.
- [Optimum Vision: Every other room gets erased.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/erased/): B2B brand film. A 56-second film for a Karachi digital-signage company: the places a visitor forgets turn into pencil and rub away. The room with the Optimum wall stays.
- [Glint & Gleam: A founder interview that feels recorded, not rendered.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/ggpod/): Founder interview ad. A 1:47 interview with an AI founder in his workshop, cut like the founder ads that sell.
- [ORAKSER: One ® on a signboard.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/orakser/): AI UGC testimonial ad. A 37-second selfie-style ad for a Karachi trademark firm. A restaurant owner explains why he registered his name before anything else.
- [Stately: A luxury study set, without a reshoot.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/stately/): Background replacement. Four minutes of creator footage moved from a plain wall into a lamp-lit walnut study.
- [Stately: Walk in like you own the room.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/walkin/): Brand B-roll ad. A 10-second suit ad built around one real product from Stately’s store, worn by an AI model who walks a busy office like he belongs there.
- [Cherat Packaging: From cylinder to country.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/cherat/): Website hero film. A 12-second seamless loop behind a packaging maker’s new homepage: four processes, three seconds each, ending in the plant hall.
- [Dynamic Learning Hub: A learning brand’s YouTube series, in two visual worlds.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/dlh/): Educational series. A 3D counting rhyme for toddlers and a realistic fractions lesson for Grade 3, both ending on the school’s enrollment call.
- [Dynamic Learning Hub: Thirteen letters, three kids, one song.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/dlhabc/): Kids rhyme · Episode 1, A to M. A 2:15 3D alphabet rhyme for toddlers. Kofi, Amara and Leo jump through A to M in one playroom, to an original song.
- [New Horizon Integration Systems: Everyone’s asleep. Not me.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/nhis/): Pitch · brand film + logo sting. A 45-second film where a smart building narrates its own night, plus a 6.5-second logo sting where the lights go out and the building wakes up.
- [Swapp: The fastest punch on Earth.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/swapp/): Test reel · car rental. A paid test reel for a UAE car-rental app. A mantis shrimp throws the fastest punch in nature, then the narration turns on one word and lands on your car.
- [Sans Air Purifier Mini: The filter had to look used.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/sansdirty/): VFX revision on real footage. A client note on a filmed UGC clip: make the filter look dirty. Fixed in post, in 4K at 60 frames, with the creator’s hands moving over it.
- [Sans Air Purifier Mini: “My family didn’t believe me.”](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/sans/): TikTok Shop UGC ad. A 44-second family-reaction ad where the proof, a filter full of dust, lands in the very first frame.
- [BUNN Speed Brew Elite: Minutes, not mornings lost.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/bunn/): Product use-case film. A 30-second breakfast story built from a coffee-maker review: rush, brew, one calm sip.
- [SWIFTER: Ten seconds to say Move Different.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/swifter/): Spec ad · streetwear. A self-initiated streetwear spot: one shirt, one model, eight shots and a logo that stays readable from the first frame to the last.
- [My own channel: Every role is me.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/ehsaan/): Short film · one actor, nine roles. A 2:40 Urdu short in four acts. One real face, mine, plays all nine characters, from the boss to the grandfather.
- [The Dental Clinic: The world’s waiting room.](https://hafiz-afaq-portfolio.vercel.app/work/dental/): Concept · online consultation film. A film concept for a Karachi dental clinic’s online consultations, written for Pakistanis abroad who keep putting off the dentist until the next trip home.
